```{=html}
<style>
.task-list input[type="checkbox"] { width: 1em; height: 1em; margin-right: 0.4em; }
@keyframes piece-row-pulse {
  0%   { background-color: transparent; }
  15%  { background-color: #fff3a0; outline: 2px solid #c8940a; outline-offset: 1px; }
  75%  { background-color: #fff3a0; outline: 2px solid #c8940a; outline-offset: 1px; }
  100% { background-color: transparent; outline: none; }
}
.piece-row-highlight { animation: piece-row-pulse 2.5s ease-out forwards; }
</style>
<div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
<button onclick="resetCMMChecklist();" style="font-size:0.78rem;padding:0.25rem 0.7rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:#888;cursor:pointer;">Reset checklist</button>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var CB_KEY = 'checklist:cmm';

  // ── Upload timing helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var TH2 = 'text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#999;padding:.3rem .3rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e0d6c8;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;';
  var TD2 = 'padding:.25rem .3rem;vertical-align:middle;';
  var INP2 = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:2px;background:#faf8f5;color:#2c2416;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;';

  function esc(s) { return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }
  function fmtTime(s) { var m=Math.floor(s/60),r=s%60; return m+':'+(r<10?'0':'')+r; }

  function timeBar(secs, maxSecs) {
    var over = secs > maxSecs;
    var pct = maxSecs ? Math.min(secs/maxSecs*100,100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    var ratio = maxSecs ? Math.min(secs/maxSecs,1) : 0;
    var barColor, timeColor;
    if (over) { barColor='#c0392b'; timeColor='#c0392b'; }
    else { var hue=Math.round(120+ratio*3),sat=Math.round(36+ratio*10),lit=Math.round(75-ratio*41); barColor='hsl('+hue+','+sat+'%,'+lit+'%)'; timeColor='#444'; }
    return '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 .7rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:#e8e4df;border-radius:3px;height:5px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.3rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:'+barColor+';width:'+pct+'%;height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s;"></div></div>'
      +'<span style="color:'+timeColor+';font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;">'+fmtTime(secs)+'</span>'
      +'<span style="color:#aaa;font-size:.82rem;"> / '+fmtTime(maxSecs)+' max</span>'
      +(over?'<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.75rem;margin-left:.5rem;">&#9888; over limit</span>':'')
      +'</div>';
  }

  function inlineOverWarning(secs, maxSecs) {
    return secs > maxSecs ? '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.72rem;margin-left:.4rem;">&#9888; over '+fmtTime(maxSecs)+'</span>' : '';
  }

  // ── CMM Upload time tracker ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var CMM_U_KEY = 'cmm-upload-times';
  var cmmU = {procMin:'', procSec:'', finalMin:'', finalSec:''};
  try { var _cu = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CMM_U_KEY)); if (_cu) { Object.keys(cmmU).forEach(function(k){ if(_cu[k]!==undefined) cmmU[k]=_cu[k]; }); } } catch(e) {}
  function saveCMMU() { try{localStorage.setItem(CMM_U_KEY,JSON.stringify(cmmU));}catch(e){} }

  function renderCMMUpload() {
    var c = document.getElementById('cmm-upload-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var procSecs  = (parseInt(cmmU.procMin)||0)*60  + (parseInt(cmmU.procSec)||0);
    var finalSecs = (parseInt(cmmU.finalMin)||0)*60 + (parseInt(cmmU.finalSec)||0);
    var totalSecs = procSecs + finalSecs;
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Section</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Max</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Min</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Sec</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'"></th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';
    // Process & reflection row (no individual max)
    h += '<tr>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.82rem;">Process &amp; reflection</td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">—</td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-cmmfield="procMin" value="'+esc(String(cmmU.procMin||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-cmmfield="procSec" value="'+esc(String(cmmU.procSec||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'"></td>'
      +'</tr>';
    // Final presentation row (max 7:00)
    h += '<tr>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.82rem;">Final presentation</td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">7:00</td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-cmmfield="finalMin" value="'+esc(String(cmmU.finalMin||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-cmmfield="finalSec" value="'+esc(String(cmmU.finalSec||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'">'+inlineOverWarning(finalSecs, 7*60)+'</td>'
      +'</tr>';
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    h += timeBar(totalSecs, 15*60);
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input[data-cmmfield]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() { cmmU[el.dataset.cmmfield] = el.value; saveCMMU(); renderCMMUpload(); });
    });
  }

  var boxes;
  function saveCheckboxes() {
    try{localStorage.setItem(CB_KEY,JSON.stringify((boxes||[]).map(function(b){return b.checked;})));}catch(e){}
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    boxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]'));
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.removeAttribute('disabled'); cb.style.cursor='pointer'; });
    try {
      var sv = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CB_KEY));
      if (Array.isArray(sv)) boxes.forEach(function(cb,i){ if(sv[i]!==undefined)cb.checked=!!sv[i]; });
    } catch(e) {}
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.addEventListener('change', saveCheckboxes); });

    renderCMMUpload();
  });
  window.resetCMMChecklist = function() {
    if (boxes) { boxes.forEach(function(b){b.checked=false;}); saveCheckboxes(); }
  };
})();
</script>
```

---

## Project and role

- [ ] Your **identified role** in the project is clearly stated
- [ ] Evidence of your individual contribution is distinguishable from the group's work
- [ ] The project has a clear **stated aim** that is referenced throughout the submission ([CMM B](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-b,rt-discuss))

---

## Selection of evidence

- [ ] Evidence represents the **full arc** of the project — not just the final product ([CMM A](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-a))
- [ ] Evidence is **well-chosen** — each piece serves a clear purpose in the submission ([CMM A](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-a))
- [ ] Both process evidence (drafts, rehearsals, decisions) and outcome evidence are included ([CMM A](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-a))
- [ ] Evidence directly documents your identified role and contribution ([CMM A](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-a))

---

## Discussion of the process

- [ ] **Challenges** encountered during the project are discussed with musical specificity ([CMM B](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-b,rt-discuss))
- [ ] **Successes** are discussed — not just listed, but examined for why they worked ([CMM B](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-b,rt-discuss))
- [ ] Specific **areas for development** are identified — what would you do differently? ([CMM B](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-b,rt-examine))
- [ ] Concrete **strategies for improvement** are proposed ([CMM B](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-b,rt-examine))
- [ ] Musical and collaborative **choices are evaluated** in relation to the stated aims ([CMM B](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-b,rt-evaluate))
- [ ] Discussion goes beyond description — it analyses *why* things happened, not just *what* happened ([CMM B](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-b,rt-discuss))

---

## Technical and musical proficiency

- [ ] Technical proficiency in your identified role is clearly demonstrated in the evidence ([CMM C](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-c,rt-realize))
- [ ] Your contribution shows genuine **musical understanding**, not just mechanical execution ([CMM C](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-c,rt-realize))
- [ ] Your musicianship serves the **overall aims** of the project ([CMM C](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-c,rt-realize))

---

## Organisation and presentation

```{=html}
<div id="cmm-upload-tracker" style="margin-bottom:1rem;"></div>
```

- [ ] The multimedia presentation is within **15 minutes** and viewable in a single sitting without pausing ([CMM D](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-d))
- [ ] The **final presentation** portion does not exceed **7 minutes** (no fixed maximum for process and reflection) ([CMM D](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-d))
- [ ] Narrative (voice-over or subtitles) is **integrated throughout** — not added as a separate document ([CMM D](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-d))
- [ ] The presentation is **logically organised**: project plan → process evidence → final presentation ([CMM D](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-d))
- [ ] Evidence is clearly **labelled** — the examiner can locate each piece without confusion ([CMM D](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-d))
- [ ] The argument of the submission is clear: project, role, contribution, reflection ([CMM D](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-d))
- [ ] Presentation quality is **consistent and professional** throughout ([CMM D](../resources/rubrics.html#cmm-d))
